 ## About section

 ### Name

 `gestalt-core`

 ### Description

 Production-grade headless multi-agent operations framework built on a single LangGraph super-graph with a central orchestrator, shared blackboard memory, typed protocols, and deployment-ready observability.

 ### Short description

 Headless multi-agent ops framework with one LangGraph super-graph.

 ## Suggested social preview copy

 `gestalt-core` is an open-source, headless software-operations framework for teams that want one orchestrator, one shared memory plane, and one LangGraph super-graph backed by production-grade deployment and observability assets.
